items.a: No. Tikpal includes 200 AI minutes every month, and core recording stays available without a subscription.

items.q: Does Tikpal work without my phone?
items.a: Recording works on its own. The Tikpal App is where you review, organize and configure.
You can record offline. Captures sync when Wi-Fi becomes available.
On-device first — 16GB of local storage — and synchronized only when you choose.
Yes. Review, export and delete your captures any time.

items.q: What if I don't like it?
items.a: 30-day returns — change your mind, no questions asked.

items.q: Does it work with iPhone and Android?
items.a: Yes — the Tikpal App works with both.

items.q: What happens after I use my 200 AI minutes?
items.a: Your 200 AI minutes refresh every month — unused minutes don't roll over. If you run out, AI features pause until the next month, but you can keep recording and everything stays saved on the device.
Most orders arrive within 5–10 business days in the US and Asia-Pacific, and 7–12 business days in Europe. Exact estimates are shown at checkout.
Import duties or taxes may apply depending on your country's customs rules and aren't included in the price.
